title: Correct emf value
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the electromotive force must be 15 V.

title: Correct internal resistance
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the internal resistance must be 2 Ω.

title: Correct R2 current
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the current through R2 when S2 is at c must be 3.75 A.

title: Correct maximum power point
description: Essential: The student must correctly identify point c as the connection for maximum output power.

title: Correct maximum power value
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the maximum output power must be 28.125 W.

title: Setup for two switch states
description: Important: The solution must apply Ohm's law to set up two independent equations using the given currents for states a and b.

title: Equivalent resistance calculation
description: Important: For the state with S2 at a, the solution must correctly calculate the parallel equivalent of R1 and R2 as 1 Ω.

title: Application of maximum power theorem
description: Important: The reasoning for part (3) must correctly apply the condition for maximum power transfer (load resistance equals internal resistance).

title: Sign or algebraic error
description: Pitfall: Deduct points for sign errors in circuit equations or algebraic mistakes in solving for E and r.

title: Unit omission or misuse
description: Pitfall: Deduct points for omitting units (V, Ω, A, W) in final answers or using incorrect units in calculations.
